BohrSet.statement: For an additive group $G$, a Bohr set on $G$ consists of a finite set of characters of $G$ (the frequencies) together with an extended nonnegative real width for each frequency $\psi$. It is thought of as the set $\{x : \|1 - \psi(x)\| \le \text{width}(\psi) \text{ for all frequencies } \psi\}$ (the chord-length convention).
